name: reporter_cluster_gauge_handbook
description: Complete handbook test for Gauge family reporters: gauge (L1-L7), cs_gauge (L1-L5). 12 layouts total, each in its own category.
source:
# ========================================================================
# Gauge Family Handbook — All Layouts
# Assets: SPY, QQQ, DIA | Timeframe: 1D
# ========================================================================

# === Market Data ===
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
rsi_14 = rsi(period=14)(close)
daily_ret = (close - (close >> 1)) / (close >> 1)
cum_ret = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(daily_ret)
sma_200 = sma(period=200)(close)

# Breadth proxy: % distance from 200-day SMA (normalized 0-1)
breadth = (close - sma_200) / sma_200

# ========================================================================
# GAUGE (per-asset) — L1 through L7
# ========================================================================

# L1: Basic numerical — RSI with default range
gauge(title='L1: RSI', category='01 gauge L1: Basic',
      agg=AggregationType.Last, min=0, max=100)(value=rsi_14)

# L2: Dial mode (needle instead of solid arc)
gauge(title='L2: RSI (Dial)', category='02 gauge L2: Dial',
      agg=AggregationType.Last, min=0, max=100,
      solid=False)(value=rsi_14)

# L3: Traffic light colors (red-yellow-green gradient)
gauge(title='L3: RSI (Traffic Light)', category='03 gauge L3: Traffic Light',
      agg=AggregationType.Last, min=0, max=100,
      use_traffic_light_colors=True)(value=rsi_14)

# L4: Custom color (blue)
gauge(title='L4: RSI (Blue)', category='04 gauge L4: Custom Color',
      agg=AggregationType.Last, min=0, max=100,
      color=Color.Blue)(value=rsi_14)

# L5: Percent format with traffic light
gauge(title='L5: Cumulative Return', category='05 gauge L5: Percent',
      agg=AggregationType.Last, min=-0.5, max=0.5,
      value_type=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat, decimal_places=2,
      use_traffic_light_colors=True)(value=cum_ret)

# L6: Categorical 3 zones
gauge(title='L6: RSI Zones', category='06 gauge L6: 3 Zones',
      agg=AggregationType.Last, min=0, max=100,
      categories=['Oversold', 'Neutral', 'Overbought'])(value=rsi_14)

# L7: Categorical 5 zones
gauge(title='L7: RSI Sentiment', category='07 gauge L7: 5 Zones',
      agg=AggregationType.Last, min=0, max=100,
      categories=['Very Oversold', 'Oversold', 'Neutral', 'Overbought', 'Very Overbought']
)(value=rsi_14)

# ========================================================================
# CS_GAUGE (cross-sectional) — L1 through L5
# ========================================================================

# L1: Basic mean RSI across assets
cs_gauge(title='L1: Mean RSI', category='08 cs_gauge L1: Basic',
         agg=AggregationType.Mean, min=0, max=100)(value=rsi_14)

# L2: Dial + traffic light combined
cs_gauge(title='L2: Mean RSI (Dial+Traffic)', category='09 cs_gauge L2: Dial',
         agg=AggregationType.Mean, min=0, max=100,
         solid=False, use_traffic_light_colors=True)(value=rsi_14)

# L3: Percent breadth indicator
cs_gauge(title='L3: Avg Breadth', category='10 cs_gauge L3: Percent',
         agg=AggregationType.Mean, min=-0.5, max=0.5,
         value_type=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat, decimal_places=2)(value=breadth)

# L4: Categorical 3 zones
cs_gauge(title='L4: Market Regime', category='11 cs_gauge L4: 3 Zones',
         agg=AggregationType.Mean, min=0, max=100,
         categories=['Bearish', 'Neutral', 'Bullish'])(value=rsi_14)

# L5: Categorical 5 zones
cs_gauge(title='L5: Market Sentiment', category='12 cs_gauge L5: 5 Zones',
         agg=AggregationType.Mean, min=0, max=100,
         categories=['Extreme Fear', 'Fear', 'Neutral', 'Greed', 'Extreme Greed']
)(value=rsi_14)
